svg:svg.title: Traveling-wave envelope example for ToonScape
svg:svg.desc: Eight compatible Inkscape Envelope Deformation phase poses plus a closing keyframe. The pole edge on the right is fixed; top and bottom boundaries share one traveling displacement; amplitude grows toward the free left edge; time=4 closes exactly on time=0.

g.inkscape:label: GUIDES – traveling envelope boundaries (hide for rendering)
